title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs as Treasury yields stall, crude slips - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq touch record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields retreat from multi-year peaks and oil prices fall, while investors look ahead to the quarterly earnings season, according to Reuters.
